what: gradient inversion of the chest X-ray federation's model from one gradient step, the attack's worst case
attack: Geiping, Bauermeister, Droege and Moeller, NeurIPS 2020 (arXiv:2003.14053); reimplemented here
victims: the 4 films of the published eval_sample.json, NIH ChestX-ray14's official test split (public)

settings.optimiser: Adam, lr 0.025 on pixels in [0, 1], stepped down 10x at 3/8, 5/8 and 7/8
settings.loss: 1 - cosine over all parameters' gradients + tv x total variation
settings.network_mode: training (batch statistics), as FedAvg's local step

reading: SSIM above the best other film's means the reconstruction resembles THIS film more than any other film in the set does; PSNR and SSIM of a flat image at the mean grey are what knowing nothing gives. One step on few films is the worst case; FedAvg's update after local epochs over thousands of augmented films is much harder to invert, and secure aggregation leaves the aggregator only the sum of the hospitals' updates.
